p.espaces.b_kind_customs: Customs, freight forwarding, import-export (promote or search)
p.espaces.rg_t: ⚖️ Trade rules vary from country to country
p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, business creation, investment platforms: the official resources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, opens up the current official sources, then reads them in your own language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Assistance Centre (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): customs duties, rules and procedures for a product and country on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Roadmap (ITC): customs duties and source rules
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): country standards for products, labelling and health regulations
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs code and taxes on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_biz: Start a business and run it.
p.espaces.rg_b1: Ready to Work (World Bank): business, taxation, international trade, by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check if a platform has been marked by the regulator before trusting money
p.espaces.rg_note: Open a site in your own language: use your browser's translation, or "Understand the document" for a document. Ask an expert in that country for a critical decision.
p.espaces.cu_d: Taxes, documents, Incoterms, free official vehicles, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between countries. 24/24 ONE WORLD does not provide customs declarations: a licensed customs officer (freight carrier) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): mandates and rules for almost every country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (EU): customs duties, source rules, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and taxes applied at entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: bill of lading (sea), air freight document (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (for businesses importing or exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the products: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, licence, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: The buyer checks everything from the seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: the seller delivers the exported goods to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: the seller loads the ship; thereafter, risks and costs are the buyer's.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance charges to the port of transportation.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Everywhere prohibited or controlled: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some drugs.These lists are rejected and can be reported.
p.espaces.cu_find: Find a carrier or a carrier
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Compare the fees in your country before sending money via Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly…
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD itself does not send money and does not earn anything from these links: you compare here, then you send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Remittance Prices Worldwide (World Bank): the real cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet in many countries
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer fees are shown before sending, based on market rates.
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the sum you get: fees + exchange rate. A rate worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An identity document is usually required to both send and receive.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you just met online, or to "unlock" a prize, package, credit or visa: this is almost always fraud.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check the websites when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, calculate the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping is selling a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is authorized in your customers' country: no imitation, no regulatory product without approval.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (the "wholesale/supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs duties, VAT in the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the real delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your event: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Trade rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect customer rights: transparent prices including taxes, return rights, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or cryptocurrencies.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: banned and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a package from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
p.espaces.ds_plat: Wholesale platforms (private, not associated with 24/24 ONE WORLD)
